parameter.name: tokenOrApiKey
parameter.label: Token or API Key
parameter.description: API key for Monitoring API V1, Fleet API key for Monitoring API V2, or Spring Security token for the private API.

parameter.name: publicApiAuthentication
parameter.label: Public API V2 Authentication
parameter.description: Use a Fleet API key or OAuth site access for Monitoring API V2.

parameter.name: oAuthClientId
parameter.label: OAuth Client ID
parameter.description: Client ID of the application registered in the SolarEdge developer portal.

parameter.name: oAuthClientSecret
parameter.label: OAuth Client Secret
parameter.description: Client secret of the application registered in the SolarEdge developer portal.

parameter.name: solarId
parameter.label: Solar ID
parameter.description: The ID that identifies the solar plant at SolarEdge.

parameter.name: meterInstalled
parameter.label: Meter Installed
parameter.description: If your setup contains a Modbus meter, enable this to get more detailed data.

parameter.name: usePrivateApi
parameter.label: Private API
parameter.description: The private API allows avoiding the limit of 300 API calls per day but is less documented and therefore less stable. If no meter is available you cannot use the private API, as it does not provide live data for this kind of setup.

parameter.name: publicApiVersion
parameter.label: Public API Version
parameter.description: Version of the official SolarEdge Monitoring API. V2 supports a Fleet API key or OAuth site access.

parameter.name: liveDataPollingInterval
parameter.label: Live Data Polling Interval
parameter.description: Interval in which live data is polled from SolarEdge (in minutes). Monitoring API V1 requires at least 10 minutes; Monitoring API V2 and the private API allow intervals down to 1 minute.

parameter.name: aggregateDataPollingInterval
parameter.label: Aggregate Data Polling Interval
parameter.description: Interval in which aggregate data is polled from SolarEdge (in minutes). Monitoring API V1 requires at least 60 minutes; Monitoring API V2 and the private API allow intervals down to 5 minutes.

parameter.name: batteryCriticalLevel
parameter.label: Critical Battery Level (Private API)
parameter.description: Battery charge level below which the battery is considered critical.
